inputs: Exact 7 physical printed-cascade offers from Cycle107 under each response policy, do not resimulate, replace, or reroll
Frozen October 2026 Scryfall oracle-cards dataset via existing evaluate_decklist.Resolver, verified SHA-256 archive in GitHub Actions
One bounded externally supplied 3/3 opposing creature, existing baseline policy and opponent life [40,39,31]
algorithm: Match every response-policy offer by seed, physical eligible card ID, name, and reveal count; reject divergence
Check printed Oracle card name, type, mana value < 5, and all seven cards are actual names in canonical approved source
Separate recognized nonland cascade eligibility from actual legality, immediate effect resolvability, outcome desirability, and card strategic value
For each offered spell, classify target/choices/cost/other-rule dependencies as blockers, not zero-value penalties
Permit fixed whitelist of effect code for exact supported text only, but do not infer broad resolution from an Oracle keyword; all unknown effect values remain UNKNOWN
Group actual offered card names and blockers; annotate absolute no-removal 7 Blast fixture removals separately from cascade uncertainty
Report zero claims of win rates, challenger advantage, tested-pool zero improvement or completed Phase B/Pass C/I/J
Cross-check Cycle106 240-sample Heartless/Tree opportunity figures; describe evidence asymmetry without inferring ranking
Declare explicit next test using paired scenarios for all three exact 100-card variants, controlled opposing creature and realistic spell follow-through
hard_fail: Any inconsistent source hashes, 240 seeds, nonconserved cards, or extra/missing cast
Any discovered offer erroneously treated as printed-MV5 spell or a land
Any offered effect assigned 0, 1, or another numeric value without full tested activation/resolution
Any canonical deck/card approval state changed
limitations: No actual cascade hit casting during Cycle107; this is source-verified triage, not a simulated effect-win test
No ability to infer target/counterspell legal resolution simply from Oracle text snippets
No fair board-state comparison to Heartless or Tree until same opponent state and legally modeled casting in their paths
Classifier is conservative; many effects remain unknown rather than auto-valued
